description: Shotgun Shooting teaches firearm safety and wingshooting: safety, laws and hunting ethics, shotgun sports, shotgun parts and care, the fundamentals of hitting a moving target, and qualifying with a modern or muzzleloading shotgun under a certified instructor.

safety.note: Shooting is done only on an approved range under certified range personnel, with eye and hearing protection, following the National Range and Target Activities Manual.

outlineNote: Shotgun Shooting has general requirements and a choice of a modern shotshell option or a muzzleloading option, each with its own scoring standard. The excerpts did not show their numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet.
